limits: Repeated existing datasets are exploratory, not a new blind test. Prior test outcomes are known; new E selection uses only reserved CLC tune.
All four variants and three routes reported on six datasets, including losses. No per-test recipe/threshold/variant selection.

Uniform affine shifts are artificial input stress; no image synthesis, feature cache edits, new annotations, new material sensors, native filtering or detector training.
Repeated draws and paired affine views do not add independent training images. Natural val BCE is the checkpoint criterion.
E is a separate preregistered exploratory stage; it does not replace the D candidate frozen earlier.
